<h1 id="1-序实验背景">1 序：实验背景</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>湖仓一体架构</strong>，在当前大数据行业、AIGC时代背景下，成为企业底层数据架构的必然选择。</li>
<li>之前一直是听各种<strong>湖仓一体</strong>的概念和教程，终归是没有动手亲身体验。因此，下定决心，终于在今天把整个过程实验通了————基于 Docker + Flink + Iceberg + MinIO 构建湖仓一体架构。</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>诚然，也是踩了几个坑，目前都已趟过去了~哈哈</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>好了，小小总结一二，先讲一下<strong>选型思路</strong>和<strong>实验过程</strong>吧。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="iceberg-在湖仓一体架构演进中的作用与地位">Iceberg 在湖仓一体架构演进中的作用与地位</h2>
<h3 id="1-湖仓一体的核心矛盾">1. 湖仓一体的核心矛盾</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>传统数仓架构</strong>里：</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>数据湖</strong>（HDFS/S3/OSS）擅长存原始数据、成本低、格式灵活，但<strong>缺少 ACID、缺 schema 约束、查询慢、难做增量更新</strong></li>
<li><strong>数据仓库</strong>（Hive/ClickHouse/Redshift/Doris等）强一致、查询快，但<strong>贵、封闭、不易存原始明细（仅支持存储【结构化数据】，不支持存储【非结构化数据】、【半结构化数据】）</strong></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>湖仓一体</strong>（<code>lakehouse</code>）要解决的问题就是：<strong>用一套存储，同时具备“湖的开放廉价”和“仓的可靠高效”</strong>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-iceberg-扮演的角色">2. Iceberg 扮演的角色</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://iceberg.apache.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Apache Iceber</a> 是<strong>表格式层（Table Format）</strong>，不是【存储引擎】，也不是【计算引擎】。它坐在“存储（对象存储/ HDFS）”和“计算（Flink/Spark/Trino）”中间，提供：</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>ACID 事务</strong>：并发写不脏读，Flink 流式写入可 Exactly-Once</li>
<li><strong>隐藏分区 / 时间旅行 / 快照隔离</strong>：查某历史版本、回滚、增量读取</li>
<li><strong>开放格式</strong>：Parquet/ORC/Avro 存数据，元数据自己管，不绑定 Hive Metastore</li>
<li><strong>Schema Evolution</strong>：加列、改类型不影响老数据</li>
<li><strong>与计算引擎解耦</strong>：Flink 写、Spark 批修、Trino 查、StarRocks 加速，都行</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-行业地位">3. 行业地位</h3>
<p>在湖仓一体演进中，Iceberg 和 <strong>Delta Lake、Hudi</strong> 并列三大表格式，但趋势上：</p>
<ul>
<li>Iceberg 因<strong>完全开源、引擎中立、社区跨云活跃</strong>，逐渐成为<strong>事实标准</strong></li>
<li>国内大厂（阿里、腾讯、字节）及海外（Netflix 起源、AWS/GCP 支持）均主推</li>
<li>它把“数据湖”升级成了<strong>“可治理的湖”</strong>，是湖仓一体的关键拼图</li>
</ul>
<p>总结：<strong>没有 Iceberg/Hudi/Delta，湖仓一体只是概念；有了 Iceberg，湖才真正具备仓的能力。</strong></p>
<h2 id="基于-docker--flink--iceberg--minio-构建湖仓一体的意义">基于 Docker + Flink + Iceberg + MinIO 构建湖仓一体的意义</h2>
<h3 id="1-各组件分工">1. 各组件分工</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>MinIO</strong>：S3 兼容的对象存储，模拟 AWS S3 / 阿里 OSS，承担“湖”的底层存储</li>
<li><strong>Iceberg</strong>：表格式层，让 MinIO 上的 Parquet 文件变成“有事务的表”</li>
<li><strong>Flink</strong>：流批一体计算引擎，负责 Kafka/CDC 实时入湖、流式 ETL、写 Iceberg</li>
<li><strong>Docker</strong>：容器化编排，一键拉起整套环境，去掉 Hadoop 全家桶负担</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-这套组合的典型架构">2. 这套组合的典型架构</h3>
<pre><code>Kafka / CDC
   ↓
Flink (SQL / DataStream)
   ↓ 写 Iceberg 表（事务提交）
MinIO (s3://warehouse/db/table/)
   ↓
Trino / Spark / StarRocks 查询
</code></pre>
<p>Iceberg 元数据 + 数据文件都在 MinIO，Flink 通过 <code>catalog</code> 直接管理表。</p>
<h3 id="3-意义解读为什么这么搭有价值">3. 意义解读（为什么这么搭有价值）</h3>
<h4 id="1零云厂商绑定成本可控">（1）零云厂商绑定，成本可控</h4>
<ul>
<li>MinIO 替代 S3/OSS，本地 IDC、笔记本、内网都能跑</li>
<li>存储与计算彻底分离，扩容只加节点，不走 HDFS 老路</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="2真正轻量湖仓可落地">（2）真正“轻量湖仓”可落地</h4>
<ul>
<li>不需要部署 Hive MetaStore、HDFS、YARN</li>
<li>Docker Compose 几分钟起一套：Flink 1.18 + Iceberg 1.x + MinIO + Trino</li>
<li>适合<strong>验证 POC、教学、中小团队生产</strong></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="3流式入湖闭环">（3）流式入湖闭环</h4>
<ul>
<li>Fllink Checkpoint + Iceberg Commit 联动，实现<strong>端到端 Exactly-Once</strong></li>
<li>迟到数据、CDC 更新（Merge-on-Read）都能处理</li>
<li>批流共用同一张 Iceberg 表，避免“实时一条链路、离线一条链路”</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="4开放生态查询加速灵活">（4）开放生态，查询加速灵活</h4>
<ul>
<li>同一份 Iceberg 表：Flink 写、Trino 交互式查、Spark 补数、StarRocks 物化加速</li>
<li>不锁死某个引擎，符合“湖仓一体=开放”的初衷</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="5契合行业演进方向">（5）契合行业演进方向</h4>
<p>当前大数据趋势是：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Hadoop 退场 → 对象存储 + 表格式 + 流批一体计算</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Docker+Flink+Iceberg+MinIO 正是这个趋势的<strong>最小可用范式</strong>，也是很多公司从“Hive 数仓”迁向“湖仓一体”的试验田。</p>
<h2 id="小结">小结</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Iceberg 的地位</strong>：湖仓一体中的“表格式标准”，让数据湖获得事务、演化、快照能力，是湖变仓的关键层。</li>
<li><strong>Docker+Flink+Iceberg+MinIO 的意义</strong>：用最小依赖、全开源、可容器化的方式，把“实时入湖 + ACID 表 + 对象存储”跑通，既是学习范式，也是低成本生产落地的现实路径。</li>
</ul>
<p>如果你愿意，我可以给你一份<strong>可直接 <code>docker compose up</code> 的 Flink+Icerberg+MinIO 配置示例</strong>，包含 Kafka 入湖 SQL 和 Trino 查询验证步骤。</p>
<h1 id="2-实验过程">2 实验过程</h1>
<h2 id="组件版本">组件版本</h2>
<ul>
<li>Docker: 24.0.2</li>
<li>Docker Compose : v2.20.1-6047-g6817716</li>
<li>MinIO: minio version RELEASE.2025-02-07T23-21-09Z (commit-id=703f51164d3d0c44af41b0d86075a1f61e4779e7)</li>
<li>Flink: 2.0.2 (发布日期: 2026.4.28)</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/README.md#Build Arguments</code></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Iceberg: 1.10.1</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/README.md#Build Arguments</code></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Iceberg-Flink-Runtime: 2.0</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/README.md#Build Arguments</code></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Hadoop: 3.4.2</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/README.md#Build Arguments</code></p>
<p>解释：iceberg-flink-quickstart Demo 项目下的 <strong>Dockerfile 在构建 Flink+Icerberg 镜像时，会把 Hadoop 的 client/common 类打进镜像里，而 3.4.2 是当前 Iceberg 主线（对应 quickstart 所在分支）锁定的 Hadoop 基线版本</strong>。并不是说 quickstart 项目在运行时一定要连 HDFS，而是 Iceberg 自身对 Hadoop 有编译期/运行期依赖。</p>
<p>1、<strong>Iceberg 内核一直带着 Hadoop 依赖</strong></p>
<p>Apache Iceberg 的 <code>iceberg-core</code> 里大量用到 <code>org.apache.hadoop.*</code>（FileSystem、Path、Configuration、Hadoop catalog 实现等）。即使你用的是 <strong>REST Catalog + MinIO/S3</strong>（quickstart 默认就是这套，不碰 HDFS），Iceberg 在 JVM 里依然要走 Hadoop 的 <code>Configuration</code> 和 <code>FileSystem</code> 抽象层来做 IO 适配。</p>
<p>所以 Flink 镜像里必须有一套 Hadoop jars 在 classpath 上，版本就由构建参数 HADOOP_VERSION 控制。</p>
<p>2、<strong>为什么是 3.4.2 而不是 3.3.x？</strong></p>
<p>Iceberg 1.x 后期（大致 1.7+ 起）把默认 Hadoop 基线从 <strong>3.3.4 / 3.3.6</strong> 往 <strong>3.4.x</strong> 推，目的是拿 Hadoop 3.4 的 S3A/ABFS 改进和 CVE 修复。</p>
<p><code>iceberg-flink-quickstart</code> 这个目录跟 Iceberg 父工程的 <code>gradle.properties</code> / <code>hadoopVersion</code> 属性联动，父工程改了基线，quickstart 的 Dockerfile 用 <code>ARG HADOOP_VERSION</code> 接同一个值，README 里就同步写成 <code>3.4.2</code>。</p>
<p>3.4.2 是 Hadoop 3.4 线的一个稳定补丁版，不是随便挑的——Hadoop 3.4.0 有些早期回归，社区 quickstart 一般锁到 3.4.2。</p>
<p>3、<strong>容易误解的点</strong></p>
<p>3.1 <strong>写 <code>HADOOP_VERSION</code> ≠ quickstart 会启动 HDFS</strong>。默认 docker compose 里只有 Flink + REST Catalog + MinIO，没有 NameNode/DataNode。<code>hadoop</code> 在这里只是"Java 依赖库"，不是"集群服务"。</p>
<p>3.2 <strong>REST Catalog 路径下 Hadoop 版本基本不影响功能</strong>，因为 IO 走的是 Iceberg 的 <code>S3FileIO</code> + AWS SDK，不是 <code>hadoop s3a</code>。Hadoop 类只在 Iceberg 内部做 path 解析、metric、catalog 抽象时用。</p>
<p>3.3 如果你把 catalog 换成 <code>type=hadoop</code>（HDFS 仓库）或 Hive catalog，那这个 Hadoop 版本才真正和文件系统语义相关，3.4.2 的 S3A/HDFS client 行为就得出差异了。</p>
</blockquote>

<h4 id="修改配置可选步骤已执行">修改配置（可选步骤，已执行）</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>本步骤的<strong>目的</strong>：</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>通过修改 iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml 文件，实现：<br>
1、使用在同一宿主机的 minio （也是一个Docker容器：minio）服务，使得 docker compose up -d 时 不再单独创建 iceberg-flink-quickstart-minio-1 的容器<br>
2、将 jobmanager 容器的 Flink Web UI 的8081端口暴露到宿主机（28081）上；<br>
3、Flink 正常对接宿主机已有的 MinIO</p>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="备份原始文件-docker-composeyml">备份原始文件: docker-compose.yml</h5>
<pre><code class="language-shell">cd /volume1/docker/iceberg/docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart
cp docker-compose.yml docker-compose.bakup-at-202607291828.yml

ls -la | grep -i docker
</code></pre>
<h5 id="前提1-宿主机已部署有-minio-服务">前提1： 宿主机已部署有 MinIO 服务</h5>
<blockquote>
<p>容器服务</p>

<li>确认 minio 的部署运行情况、容器名称</li>
</ul>

</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>如果叫别的，比如 <code>minio-server</code>，那就要改成： <code>S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio-server:9000</code></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>确认 MinIO bucket 存在</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">docker exec -it minio-server sh

mc alias set local http://my-nas-device.com:9000 minioadmin &lt;密码&gt;
mc mb local/warehouse
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>或者：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">docker exec -it minio-server mc mb data/warehouse
docker exec -it minio-server mc ls /data/
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>扩展：进入 minio 容器内  (本步骤，了解即可)</li>
</ul>

sh-5.1# exit
exit
ash-4.4# 
</code></pre>
<h5 id="前提2minio-容器与-flink-容器需要在同一个-docker-网络">前提2：MinIO 容器与 Flink 容器需要<strong>在同一个 Docker 网络</strong></h5>
<blockquote>
<p>这是关键，否则 <code>jobmanager</code> 无法通过容器名访问 <code>minio</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-txt">ash-4.4# docker inspect minio-server | grep -A 20 Networks

                    "IPAMConfig": null,

                    "IPPrefixLen": 16,

<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>NetworkName = "bridge"</li>
<li>NetworkID  = 是 Docker 内部的唯一 ID
<ul>
<li>= <code>9f1b13e4e49c98838a8f887a43a2e49d6ce0845c949fa1892aae1fccb9dd4b78</code></li>
<li>= <code>9f1b13e4e49c</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="创建自定义网络">创建自定义网络</h5>
<blockquote>
<p>为解决使用<code>bridge</code>网络来启动时(<code>docker-compose up -d</code>)的错误:<code>Error response from daemon: network-scoped alias is supported only for containers in user defined networks</code></p>
<ul>
<li><code>bridge</code> 是 Docker 的“<strong>内置默认网络</strong>”</li>
<li>Docker 对它有很多限制，其中一条就是：
<ul>
<li>❌ 不支持 aliases</li>
<li>❌ 不支持 network-scoped alias</li>
<li>✅ 只允许最基础的容器通信</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>而 docker-compose.yml 中 有对 services.jobmanager/taskmanager/... . networks.iceberg_net.aliases.jobmanager 等别名的设置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>创建网络</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">ash-4.4# docker network create iceberg-net
25a6367209e888a60a3e7c4c5beb24cbe044367b10e90821c9c1c612f16f6219

ash-4.4# docker network ls
NETWORK ID     NAME                 DRIVER    SCOPE
9f1b13e4e49c   bridge               bridge    local
3056155d0119   host                 host      local
25a6367209e8   iceberg-net          bridge    local
a9ee6b998801   none                 null      local
9d19e872f309   ubuntu_default       bridge    local
74ae7857cbca   wps-office_default   bridge    local
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>把 MinIO 连到这个网络</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shekk">docker network connect iceberg-net minio-server
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>修改 docker-compose.yml（关键）</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yml">networks:
  iceberg_net:
    external: true
    # name: bridge
    name: iceberg-net
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>延申：在 整个应用运行起来后，验证 Flink / REST Catalog 是否同一个网络？</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>

</ul>

<h5 id="编辑配置文件">编辑配置文件</h5>
<ul>
<li>修改文件权限，解决文件无编辑权限的问题</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">ash-4.4# chmod -R 755 /volume1/docker/iceberg/

ash-4.4# vim docker-compose.yml
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>让 quickstart 使用这个网络</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yml">networks:
  iceberg_net:
    external: true
    name: bridge   # ← 改成实际的 MinIO 网络名
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>确保在所有 service 中均有引用它：</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-shell">services:
  jobmanager:
    networks:
      - iceberg_net

  taskmanager:
    networks:
      - iceberg_net

  # Iceberg REST Catalog
  iceberg-rest:
    networks:
      - iceberg_net
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>直接删掉整个 <code>minio:</code> service 定义</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yml">#  # MinIO for S3-compatible object storage
#  minio:
#    image: minio/minio
#    hostname: minio
#    environment:
#      MINIO_ROOT_USER: admin
#      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: password
#      MINIO_DOMAIN: minio
#    networks:
#      iceberg_net:
#        aliases:
#          - warehouse.minio
#    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
#    healthcheck:
#      test: ["CMD", "mc", "ready", "local"]
#      interval: 5s
#      timeout: 5s
#      retries: 5


#  # Create the warehouse bucket
#  create-bucket:
#    image: minio/mc
#    depends_on:
#      minio:
#        condition: service_healthy
#    networks:
#      iceberg_net:
#    entrypoint: |
#      /bin/sh -c "
#      until (/usr/bin/mc alias set minio http://minio:9000 admin password) do echo '...waiting...' &amp;&amp; sleep 1; done;
#      /usr/bin/mc rm -r --force minio/warehouse;
#      /usr/bin/mc mb minio/warehouse;
#      /usr/bin/mc policy set public minio/warehouse;
#      "
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>删除掉 <code>iceberg-rest</code> 容器对 <code>create-bucket</code> 容器的依赖</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-shell">  iceberg-rest:
    ...
    #depends_on:
    #  create-bucket:
    #    condition: service_completed_successfully
    ...
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>为什么这样 Flink 就能访问 MinIO？</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>网络拓扑</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-txt">┌───────────────────────────────┐
│ Docker default bridge network │
│         (bridge)              │
│                               │
│  minio-server :9000           │
│  jobmanager    :8081          │
│  taskmanager                 │
│  rest                         │
└───────────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
<p>✅ 容器间通信规则<br>
✅ 可以通过<strong>容器名</strong>互相访问。例如： taskmanager / jobmanager / iceberg-rest<br>
✅ minio-server:9000 是合法的 DNS<br>
❌ localhost:9000 不行（那是宿主机）</p>
<ul>
<li>所以在 Flink / REST Catalog 中必须写成：<code>http://minio-server:9000</code>，而非 <code>http://localhost:9000</code></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>暴露 JobManager 的 8081 到宿主机 28081</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>找到 <code>jobmanager</code> service，加上或修改 <code>ports</code>：</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yml">services:
  jobmanager:
    ...
    ports:
      - "28081:8081" # ← 宿主机:容器 (Flink JobManager Web UI : http://localhost:28081 )
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>修改 S3 的环境变量配置</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li ,="">service =</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yml">environment:
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1
      # AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: admin
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: minioadmin
      # AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: password
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: 《密码》
      # S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio-server:9000
      S3_PATH_STYLE_ACCESS: true
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>service =</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-shell">    environment:
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1
      #CATALOG_WAREHOUSE: s3://warehouse/
      CATALOG_WAREHOUSE: s3://lakehouse/iceberg/
      CATALOG_IO__IMPL: org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO
      #CATALOG_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      CATALOG_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio-server:9000
      #CATALOG_S3_ACCESS__KEY__ID: admin
      CATALOG_S3_ACCESS__KEY__ID: minioadmin
      #CATALOG_S3_SECRET__ACCESS__KEY: password
      CATALOG_S3_SECRET__ACCESS__KEY: 【密码】

      # 配置 REST 服务本身去访问 S3 时的 Path Style 属性
      CATALOG_S3_PATH__STYLE__ACCESS: "true"
      
      # 强制 REST 服务把这个属性下发（Override）给客户端（Flink/Spark）
      CATALOG_REST_S3_PATH__STYLE__ACCESS: "true"
      #CATALOG_REST_OPTION_S3_PATH__STYLE__ACCESS: "true"
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><code>iceberg-rest</code>容器服务所属的<code>apache/iceberg-rest-fixture</code> 镜像在把环境变量转换为 <code>REST Catalog</code> 的配置时，只认2种<strong>环境变量</strong>命名格式：</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<ol>
<li><strong><code>CATALOG_</code> 前缀双下划线模式：</strong> 环境变量名中的点（<code>.</code>）需要替换为双下划线（<code>__</code>）。因此：
<ul>
<li><code>s3.path-style-access</code> 应该写成 <strong><code>CATALOG_S3_PATH__STYLE__ACCESS</code></strong> （双下划线）。如果写成了单下划线，镜像将无法识别。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong><code>REST_</code> / <code>ICEBERG_</code> 原生属性前缀。</strong></li>
</ol>

<h5 id="构建镜像-1">构建镜像</h5>
<pre><code class="language-shell">cd /volume1/docker/iceberg

docker build \
  --build-arg FLINK_VERSION=2.0 \
  --build-arg ICEBERG_VERSION=1.10.1 \
  -t apache/iceberg-flink-quickstart \
  docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/
# 或 默认的构建策略：docker-compose -f docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml up -d --build

//查看构建完成的镜像
ash-4.4# docker images | grep -i iceberg
apache/iceberg-flink-quickstart   latest       948f09d0c182   5 minutes ago   1.06GB
</code></pre>

<h3 id="创建并启动容器">创建并启动容器</h3>
<h4 id="创建并启动容器-1">创建并启动容器</h4>
<ul>
<li>基于已构建的本地镜像，创建并启动容器</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>启动后容器里会有一个叫 <code>jobmanager</code> 的服务。</p>
</blockquote>

 注： State 列：
    Up → 正常运行
    Up (health: starting) → 正在做健康检查，等一会儿再看
    Up (unhealthy) → 健康检查失败，容器在跑但服务不正常
    Restarting → 容器反复重启，典型异常
    Exit 0 / Exit 1 / ... → 容器已经退出，需要根据退出码排查

<h2 id="demo--flink-sql--iceberg含-iceberg-rest-catalog--minio">Demo ： Flink SQL + Iceberg（含: Iceberg-Rest-Catalog） + MinIO</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>正式开始 Demo 体验。<br>
首先，需要进入 Flink SQL Client 窗口。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="在-flink-中创建-iceberg-catalog-和-database">在 Flink 中创建 Iceberg Catalog 和 Database</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Iceberg 支持多种可用于跟踪表的 Catalog 后端，例如 JDBC、Hive MetaStore 和 Glue。在本指南中，我们使用由 S3 支持的 REST Catalog。要了解更多信息，请查看 Flink 章节中的 <a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-configuration/#catalog-configuration" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Catalog</a> 页面。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>首先，我们需要定义一个 Flink Catalog。此 Catalog 中的表将存储在 S3 对象存储中。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE CATALOG iceberg_catalog WITH (
  'type'                 = 'iceberg',
  'catalog-impl'         = 'org.apache.iceberg.rest.RESTCatalog',
  'uri'                  = 'http://iceberg-rest:8181',
  'warehouse'            = 's3://lakehouse/icebgerg/',
  'io-impl'              = 'org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO',
  's3.endpoint'          = 'http://minio-server:9000',
  's3.access-key-id'     = 'minioadmin',
  's3.secret-access-key' = 'password_xxx',
  's3.path-style-access' = 'true'
);
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><code>'warehouse' = 's3://warehouse/'</code> ==&gt; <code>'warehouse' = 's3://lakehouse/icebgerg/'</code></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>在 Catalog 中创建一个数据库</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Flink SQL&gt; CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS iceberg_catalog.nyc;
[INFO] Execute statement succeeded.
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>可以理解为 数据库的完整库名为: <code>&lt;catalogName&gt;.&lt;databaseName&gt;</code>，例如： <code>iceberg_catalog.nyc</code></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="创建表">创建表</h3>
<ul>
<li>要在 Flink 中创建您的第一个 Iceberg 表，请运行 <a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-ddl/#create-table" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>CREATE TABLE</code></a> 命令。让我们使用 <code>iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis</code> 创建一个表，其中 <code>iceberg_catalog</code> 是 Catalog 名称，<code>nyc</code> 是数据库名称，<code>taxis</code> 是表名称。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">CREATE TABLE iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis
(
    vendor_id BIGINT,
    trip_id BIGINT,
    trip_distance FLOAT,
    fare_amount DOUBLE,
    store_and_fwd_flag STRING
);
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>此时，<strong>对象存储的桶</strong>中将存在类似的目录与文件:</p>
<p><code>warehouse/nyc/taxis/metadata/00000-ef520259-980a-4535-87b0-8ec9dbcf26a3.metadata.json</code></p>
<blockquote>
<p>文件内容：</p>
<blockquote>
<p><code>format-version</code> 属性：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Iceberg目前有两个表版本（V1和V2），根据数据选择合适的表版本：</p>
<p>V1表只支持增量数据插入，适合做纯增量写入场景，如埋点数据。</p>
<p>V2表才支持行级更新，适合做状态变化的更新，如订单表同步。</p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
	"format-version": 2,
	"table-uuid": "0e98eefa-f368-4b17-a459-17edca936410",
	"location": "s3://lakehouse/iceberg/nyc/taxis",
	"last-sequence-number": 0,
	"last-updated-ms": 1785398232040,
	"last-column-id": 5,
	"current-schema-id": 0,
	"schemas": [
		{
			"type": "struct",
			"schema-id": 0,
			"fields": [
				{ "id": 1, "name": "vendor_id", "required": false, "type": "long" },
				{ "id": 2, "name": "trip_id", "required": false, "type": "long" },
				{ "id": 3, "name": "trip_distance", "required": false, "type": "float" },
				{ "id": 4, "name": "fare_amount", "required": false, "type": "double" },
				{ "id": 5, "name": "store_and_fwd_flag", "required": false, "type": "string" }
			]
		}
	],
	"default-spec-id": 0,
	"partition-specs": [ { "spec-id": 0, "fields": [] } ],
	"last-partition-id": 999,
	"default-sort-order-id": 0,
	"sort-orders": [ { "order-id": 0, "fields": [] } ],
	"properties": { "write.parquet.compression-codec": "zstd" },
	"current-snapshot-id": -1,
	"refs": {},
	"snapshots": [],
	"statistics": [],
	"partition-statistics": [],
	"snapshot-log": [],
	"metadata-log": []
}
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Iceberg Catalog 支持完整的 Flink SQL DDL 命令，包括：</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-ddl/#partitioned-by" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>CREATE TABLE ... PARTITIONED BY</code></a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-ddl/#alter-table" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>ALTER TABLE</code></a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-ddl/#drop-table" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>DROP TABLE</code></a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="向表中写入数据">向表中写入数据</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>表创建完成后，您就可以插入记录了。</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Flink 使用 Checkpoint 来确保<strong>数据持久性</strong>和<strong>精确一次</strong>（exactly-once）语义。如果没有开启 Checkpoint，Iceberg 的数据和元数据可能无法完整提交到存储中。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>Flink SQL&gt; SET 'execution.checkpointing.interval' = '10s';
[INFO] Execute statement succeeded.
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>然后，可以写入一些数据：</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>vendor_id / trip_id / trip_distance / fare_amount / store_and_flag</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code>INSERT INTO iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis
VALUES 
  (1, 1000371, 1.8, 15.32, 'N')
  , (2, 1000372, 2.5, 22.15, 'N')
  , (2, 1000373, 0.9, 9.01, 'N')
  , (1, 1000374, 8.4, 42.13, 'Y');
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>响应内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-log">Flink SQL&gt; 
&gt; INSERT INTO iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis
&gt; ...
[INFO] Submitting SQL update statement to the cluster...
[INFO] SQL update statement has been successfully submitted to the cluster:
Job ID: 293e34bec6f528d96b7f709bf9b0a617
</code></pre>
<p>当 checkpoint 完成周期性的提交后，<strong>Flink Job Manager</strong> - Web UI - Jobs - Completed Jobs 中将存在1条 JobName=<code>insert-into_iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis</code>、JobID=<code>293e34bec6f528d96b7f709bf9b0a617</code>、JobType=<code>STREAMING</code>的记录。该作业的详情可访问: <a href="http://my-nas-device.com:28081/#/job/completed/293e34bec6f528d96b7f709bf9b0a617/overview" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://my-nas-device.com:28081/#/job/completed/293e34bec6f528d96b7f709bf9b0a617/overview</a></p>
<p>此时，<strong>对象存储的桶</strong>中将存在类似的目录与文件:</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">warehouse/nyc/taxis
  /data/00000-0-78f59a93-e76d-4f7e-862f-98a6443dfb6e-00001.parquet
  /metadata/
      00000-ef520259-980a-4535-87b0-8ec9dbcf26a3.metadata.json (此文件在建表时即会存在)
      00001-e53e7252-f757-469f-9cfe-07fdc6c5aef6.metadata.json
      50b28b70-a9f6-4fb8-a5cc-765a22abded9-m0.avro
      snap-257888749078048997-1-50b28b70-a9f6-4fb8-a5cc-765a22abded9.avro
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="读取表数据">读取表数据</h3>
<ul>
<li>要读取表，请使用 Iceberg 表的名称</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">//错误示范1
Flink SQL&gt; SELECT * FROM taxis;
[ERROR] Could not execute SQL statement. Reason:
org.apache.calcite.sql.validate.SqlValidatorException: Object 'taxis' not found

//错误示范2
Flink SQL&gt; SELECT * FROM nyc.taxis;
[ERROR] Could not execute SQL statement. Reason:
org.apache.calcite.sql.validate.SqlValidatorException: Object 'nyc' not found


//正确示范
&gt; SELECT * FROM iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis;

                                                                           SQL Query Result (Table)                                                                           
 Table program finished.                                                       Page: Last of 1                                                          Updated: 07:43:54.543 

vendor_id      trip_id                  trip_distance                    fare_amount             store_and_fwd_flag
1              1000371                            1.8                          15.32                              N
2              1000372                            2.5                          22.15                              N
2              1000373                            0.9                           9.01                              N
1              1000374                            8.4                          42.13                              Y

</code></pre>
<h3 id="通过内联配置创建表">通过内联配置创建表</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>如上所示创建一个由 <strong>Iceberg REST Catalog</strong> 支持的 <strong>Flink Catalog</strong> 是在 Flink 中使用 Iceberg 的一种方式。另一种方式是使用 <a href="https://iceberg.org.cn/docs/latest/flink-connector/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Flink connector</a> 并在表定义中直接指定 Catalog 连接详细信息。这种方式仍然连接到同一个外部 Iceberg REST Catalog，区别在于你不需要单独执行 <code>CREATE CATALOG</code> 语句。</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用内联配置创建表：</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>这里的 Flink 表定义在 Flink <strong>默认的内存 Catalog</strong> (<code>default_catalog</code>) 中注册，但<strong>连接器属性</strong>会告诉 Flink 将该 <strong>Iceberg 表及其数据</strong>存储在与之前相同的 REST Catalog 和 S3 存储中，对应的 Catalog / Database 分别为: default_catalog / default_database。</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE taxis_inline_config (
    vendor_id BIGINT,
    trip_id BIGINT,
    trip_distance FLOAT,
    fare_amount DOUBLE,
    store_and_fwd_flag STRING
) WITH (
    'connector'            = 'iceberg',
    'catalog-name'         = 'foo', -- Required by Flink connector but value doesn't matter for inline config
    'catalog-type'         = 'rest',
    'uri'                  = 'http://iceberg-rest:8181',
    'warehouse'            = 's3://lakehouse/iceberg/',
    'io-impl'              = 'org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO',
    's3.endpoint'          = 'http://minio-server:9000',
    's3.access-key-id'     = 'minioadmin',
    's3.secret-access-key' = 'password_xxx',
    's3.path-style-access' = 'true'
);


//写数据
INSERT INTO default_database.taxis_inline_config
VALUES 
  (1, 1000371, 1.8, 15.32, 'N')
  , (2, 1000372, 2.5, 22.15, 'N')
  , (2, 1000373, 0.9, 9.01, 'N')
  , (1, 1000374, 8.4, 42.13, 'Y');

-- 响应内容: 
[INFO] Submitting SQL update statement to the cluster...
[INFO] SQL update statement has been successfully submitted to the cluster:
Job ID: 5360c5c5f785a57e4322a2c159c1391e


//查询表数据 （查询方式稍有不同，可对比）
Flink SQL&gt; select * from iceberg_catalog.default_database.taxis_inline_config; -- 查询方式0
Flink SQL&gt; select * from default_database.taxis_inline_config;  -- 查询方式1
Flink SQL&gt; select * from taxis_inline_config;  -- 查询方式2
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>此时，这张表即会在对应的目录下创建:</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">lakehouse/iceberg/default_database/taxis_inline_config/metadata/
    00000-5a8c92fe-533d-4121-a597-7226a093ae51.metadata.json
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>其文件内容：</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
	"format-version": 2,
	"table-uuid": "79720fbb-9fb9-4b42-9f6e-baf75c1f2d7d",
	"location": "s3://lakehouse/iceberg/default_database/taxis_inline_config",
	"last-sequence-number": 0,
	"last-updated-ms": 1785399057242,
	"last-column-id": 5,
	"current-schema-id": 0,
	"schemas": [
		{
			"type": "struct",
			"schema-id": 0,
			"fields": [
				{ "id": 1, "name": "vendor_id", "required": false, "type": "long" },
				{ "id": 2, "name": "trip_id", "required": false, "type": "long" },
				{ "id": 3, "name": "trip_distance", "required": false, "type": "float" },
				{ "id": 4, "name": "fare_amount", "required": false, "type": "double" },
				{ "id": 5, "name": "store_and_fwd_flag", "required": false, "type": "string" }
			]
		}
	],
	"default-spec-id": 0,
	"partition-specs": [ { "spec-id": 0, "fields": [] } ],
	"last-partition-id": 999,
	"default-sort-order-id": 0,
	"sort-orders": [ { "order-id": 0, "fields": [] } ],
	"properties": {
		"s3.path-style-access": "true",
		"s3.access-key-id": "minioadmin",
		"s3.secret-access-key": "password_xxx",
		"s3.endpoint": "http://minio-server:9000",
		"io-impl": "org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO",
		"write.parquet.compression-codec": "zstd",
		"catalog-type": "rest",
		"catalog-name": "foo",
		"warehouse": "s3://lakehouse/iceberg/",
		"uri": "http://iceberg-rest:8181"
	},
	"current-snapshot-id": -1,
	"refs": {},
	"snapshots": [],
	"statistics": [],
	"partition-statistics": [],
	"snapshot-log": [],
	"metadata-log": []
}
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="常见操作">常见操作</h2>
<h3 id="进入容器内部">进入容器内部</h3>
<pre><code class="language-shell">ash-4.4# docker run --rm -it apache/iceberg-flink-quickstart:latest /bin/bash
flink@2a505077f4db:~$ 
flink@2a505077f4db:~$ cat /etc/os-release 
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS"
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
VERSION="22.04.5 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)"
VERSION_CODENAME=jammy
ID=ubuntu
ID_LIKE=debian
HOME_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://help.ubuntu.com/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/"
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/legal/terms-and-policies/privacy-policy"
UBUNTU_CODENAME=jammy
flink@2a505077f4db:~$ exit
exit

ash-4.4# 
</code></pre>
<h3 id="停止运行">停止运行</h3>
<pre><code class="language-shell">cd /volume1/docker/iceberg/docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart
docker-compose down

或 docker-compose -f docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml down
</code></pre>
<h1 id="3-使用指南flink-sql-client">3 使用指南(Flink SQL Client)</h1>
<h2 id="catalog--database-管理">Catalog / Database 管理</h2>
<ul>
<li>使用指定的 Catalog、Database</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Flink SQL&gt; USE CATALOG default_catalog;
[INFO] Execute statement succeeded.

Flink SQL&gt; USE default_database;
[INFO] Execute statement succeeded.
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>查看当前有哪些 Catalog、Database；查看当前使用的哪个 Catalog 、Database？</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">Flink SQL&gt; SHOW CURRENT CATALOG;
+----------------------+
| current catalog name |
+----------------------+
|      default_catalog |
+----------------------+
1 row in set

Flink SQL&gt; SHOW CURRENT DATABASE;
+-----------------------+
| current database name |
+-----------------------+
|      default_database |
+-----------------------+
1 row in set

Flink SQL&gt; show databases;
+------------------+
|    database name |
+------------------+
| default_database |
+------------------+
1 row in set

Flink SQL&gt; show catalogs;
+-----------------+
|    catalog name |
+-----------------+
| default_catalog |
| iceberg_catalog |
+-----------------+
2 rows in set


//Flink 支持带全限定名或 IN 子句，不用 USE 也能列：
-- 列出指定 catalog 下的库
Flink SQL&gt; SHOW DATABASES FROM iceberg_catalog;
+------------------+
|    database name |
+------------------+
| default_database |
|              nyc |
+------------------+
2 rows in set

-- 列出指定 catalog.db 下的表
Flink SQL&gt; SHOW TABLES FROM iceberg_catalog.nyc;
+------------+
| table name |
+------------+
|      taxis |
+------------+
1 row in set
或:
Flink SQL&gt; SHOW TABLES IN iceberg_catalog.nyc;
+------------+
| table name |
+------------+
|      taxis |
+------------+
1 row in set
-- 模糊匹配表名
Flink SQL&gt; SHOW TABLES FROM iceberg_catalog.nyc LIKE '%ta%';
+------------+
| table name |
+------------+
|      taxis |
+------------+
1 row in set
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>查看 指定 Catalog 的定义</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Flink SQL&gt; SHOW CREATE CATALOG iceberg_catalog;
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           result |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CREATE CATALOG `iceberg_catalog`
WITH (
  'catalog-impl' = 'org.apache.iceberg.rest.RESTCatalog',
  'io-impl' = 'org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO',
  's3.access-key-id' = 'minioadmin',
  's3.endpoint' = 'http://minio-server:9000',
  's3.path-style-access' = 'true',
  's3.secret-access-key' = 'password_xxx',
  'type' = 'iceberg',
  'uri' = 'http://iceberg-rest:8181',
  'warehouse' = 's3://lakehouse/icebgerg/'
)
 |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set
</code></pre>
<h2 id="table-管理">Table 管理</h2>
<ul>
<li>查看表的定义</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- 直接查表结构
Flink SQL&gt; DESCRIBE iceberg_catalog.nyc.taxis;
+--------------------+--------+------+-----+--------+-----------+
|               name |   type | null | key | extras | watermark |
+--------------------+--------+------+-----+--------+-----------+
|          vendor_id | BIGINT | TRUE |     |        |           |
|            trip_id | BIGINT | TRUE |     |        |           |
|      trip_distance |  FLOAT | TRUE |     |        |           |
|        fare_amount | DOUBLE | TRUE |     |        |           |
| store_and_fwd_flag | STRING | TRUE |     |        |           |
+--------------------+--------+------+-----+--------+-----------+
5 rows in set
</code></pre>
<h1 id="f-附件">F 附件</h1>
<h2 id="f1-dockericeberg-flink-quickstartdocker-composeyml-原始配置">F.1 <code>docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml</code> (原始配置)</h2>
<blockquote>
<p><code>/volume1/docker/iceberg/docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml</code></p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yml"># Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
# or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
# distributed with this work for additional information
# regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
# to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
# "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
# with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#   http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
# software distributed under the License is distributed on an
# "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
# KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
# specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.
#

# Flink Quickstart with Apache Iceberg
#
# Usage:
#   docker compose -f docker/iceberg-flink-quickstart/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
#
# Connect to SQL client:
#   docker exec -it jobmanager ./bin/sql-client.sh
services:
  # Flink JobManager
  jobmanager:
    build: .
    hostname: jobmanager
    container_name: jobmanager
    depends_on:
      iceberg-rest:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
    command: jobmanager
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8081/overview"]
      start_period: 30s
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    environment:
      FLINK_PROPERTIES: |
        jobmanager.rpc.address: jobmanager
        taskmanager.numberOfTaskSlots: 2
        parallelism.default: 2
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: admin
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: password
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000

  # Flink TaskManager
  taskmanager:
    build: .
    hostname: taskmanager
    depends_on:
      jobmanager:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
    command: taskmanager
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
    environment:
      FLINK_PROPERTIES: |
        jobmanager.rpc.address: jobmanager
        taskmanager.numberOfTaskSlots: 2
        parallelism.default: 2
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: admin
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: password
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000

  # Iceberg REST Catalog
  iceberg-rest:
    image: apache/iceberg-rest-fixture
    hostname: iceberg-rest
    depends_on:
      create-bucket:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8181/v1/config"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    environment:
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1
      CATALOG_WAREHOUSE: s3://warehouse/
      CATALOG_IO__IMPL: org.apache.iceberg.aws.s3.S3FileIO
      CATALOG_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      CATALOG_S3_ACCESS__KEY__ID: admin
      CATALOG_S3_SECRET__ACCESS__KEY: password

  # MinIO for S3-compatible object storage
  minio:
    image: minio/minio
    hostname: minio
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: admin
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: password
      MINIO_DOMAIN: minio
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
        aliases:
          - warehouse.minio
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mc", "ready", "local"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # Create the warehouse bucket
  create-bucket:
    image: minio/mc
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      iceberg_net:
    entrypoint: |
      /bin/sh -c "
      until (/usr/bin/mc alias set minio http://minio:9000 admin password) do echo '...waiting...' &amp;&amp; sleep 1; done;
      /usr/bin/mc rm -r --force minio/warehouse;
      /usr/bin/mc mb minio/warehouse;
      /usr/bin/mc policy set public minio/warehouse;
      "

networks:
  iceberg_net:

</code></pre>
